card.name: Ending pieces like -oux, -ux, -qx, -ex
card.fires_on: The final piece of a rare name or drug name that ends in x, such as -oux, -ux, -ex or -qx. It appears in French-style surnames and place names, and in drug names such as penpulimab-kcqx and moexipril.

modes.label: French surnames and places
modes.description: The ending -oux or -ux closes a French-style surname or village name.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: An x-ending piece sits inside or at the end of a drug name, including the four-letter suffix after a biologic's hyphen.
